citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:45 PM on
8/13/2026. The inspector called the licensee who stated he was at work and unavailable for an inspection. The licensee
stated the other two facility representatives were also not available to accompany the inspector. Failure to provide access
to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide
access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
